subject.title: fix(talk): diagnose invalid OpenAI realtime auth

question: Should OpenClaw expose `OPENCLAW_OPENAI_REALTIME_ALLOW_UNVALIDATED_KEY` as a supported process-wide escape hatch, or should direct-key validation rely only on confirmed Azure/proxy signatures and sanitized provider failures?
rationale: This is a new environment surface in shared authentication behavior; repository policy requires an explicit reason that existing routing, defaults, and diagnostics cannot provide the needed compatibility path.

options.title: Remove the override and keep narrow detection
options.body: Reject only positively identified Azure/proxy credentials and let unknown formats reach the provider, preserving compatibility without a new operator setting.

options.title: Adopt a documented override contract
options.body: Keep the environment variable only with explicit owner approval, clear scope, and upgrade/support expectations for every shared voice surface.

recommendation.title: Remove the override and keep narrow detection
recommendation.body: Reject only positively identified Azure/proxy credentials and let unknown formats reach the provider, preserving compatibility without a new operator setting.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged related implementation establishes the current authentication-routing contract that this branch must extend safely.
